calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Oct-22-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change of Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Charles Crompton, Clerk: A. Mok and M. Grier. Case not called on the record. Proceedings not reported.

Petitioners father Danilo Visnich of minor present in court.
No appearance by or on behalf of mother of minor Cassandra Campbell.
Proof of Publication on file.

Petitioner submitted Custody and Visitation Order from Superior Court of Marin County granting Change of Name of both minors to court and returned to Petitioner.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and the petition should be granted.

The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from current name Santino Carmine Pasquale Campbell to new name Carmine Pasquale Campbell-Visnich.

The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from current name Milania Giatta Campbell to new name Milania Giatta Campbell-Visnich.

Decree Changing Name signed by the court.
